# ENV005: Requested TCP port is already in use

<!-- Code generated by cmd/rulegen from the builtin registry. DO NOT EDIT. -->

Component: network. Severity: error.

Collector prerequisites: network.

A listening process already holds a port requested for this application.

Evidence required: An observed TCP listener on a port explicitly requested with --port.

Manual steps:

- Choose another port or stop the identified process after confirming it is safe to stop.

Verify with `envdoctor diagnose --rule ENV005`.

Limitations:

- PID/process names can be unavailable when OS permissions deny ownership metadata.
- No port inspection runs without --port. Verification appends the affected ports.
